name: VPC Traffic Mirroring Collection
description: VPC Traffic Mirroring copies packets from a network interface to a destination the attacker chooses. It is meant for troubleshooting. Used badly, it is a tap on unencrypted traffic between applications: credentials, session cookies, database queries. Nothing is changed on the source instance, so hosts look healthy. New mirror sessions that are not part of a packet-capture request are collection, not debugging.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
